villageLost.beat: Haven couldn't hold. On the third hungry day, people started walking — in different directions. The scattering, again.

deathDayLines.line: — DAY 16 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
On the carcass nearby, Lockpick (carcass) went bad — maggots, smell, the whole sad story. Leaving it had a cost.
Mariela Lazzari reads the sky: clear tomorrow, cold.
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
You wake with a start — something is wrong.
SYSTEM: Codex and inventory overlay online.
◈ THE TRIAL — the audience is restless. The System offers Adrian a trial, broadcast live. Survive it and take the slot. Refuse it and... well. The audience remembers refusals. (Ability slots: 4)

◈ RESONANCE HARMONICS — SYSTEM: "HYPOTHESIS CONFIRMED. Objects with high observer-attention waveforms function as auxiliary capacitors. We call this RESONANCE HARMONICS. We do not know why the waveforms taste like grief. We have stopped asking." — Hold a keepsake. Think about them. The System will do the math. (It is not math. It is love. The System will never know.) Channel keepsakes from your pack.
SYSTEM: "DEMONSTRATION. Give me that — Dad's Thermos. WATCH."
📓 Codex: you UNDERSTAND **Scar Tissue**.
⬆️ Survivor deepened to L2! Endurance is identity.
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
💛 You hold Dad's Thermos and practice — one gift, deeply. They would want you to get better at this. (+6 experience to Survivor)
★ IDENTIFIED: Daylily Bud. Daylily. Tawny trumpet flowers, long buds. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
SYSTEM: Catalogued. The Codex grows teeth.
You are full enough.
The pantry is in the hall. Your hands are not.
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
Brian hesitates, then backs off. "Not today. Sorry." (Low trust — reluctant.)
🌱 Cameron waters and weeds the beds before taking up other work. The harvest can wait.

🌿 Cameron checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~20 days of fresh on hand… leaves the harvest standing and turns to the stone pile instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.
🪨 Cameron pries 2 stone loose from the creek bed. The building pile grows. (16 stone now.)
🪵 Brian hauls back 6 wood. The pile grows. (80 logs now.)
🍲 Brian cooked for the haven — meals stretched.
You catch fragments by the fire — Landon telling Tullio about themself. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.
Adrian showed Landon the Mahua — "remember it." Word gets around.
Cameron heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
🩹 Landon is still hurting (23 HP) — no healer at haven. They rest today instead of ranging out.
Tullio heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
Marcus heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
🩹 Dmitri is still hurting (35 HP) — no healer at haven. They rest today instead of ranging out.
🚶 Ruth is back — found Ella.
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
📋 Brian — 💧 Fetch water. They'll report back by next part.
"Can we talk?" Zoe sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to." (Talk to Zoe.)
💧 Brian returns with 10L of creek water. Risky until the hearth boils it.
Brian heads out to check the snares. "Wire doesn't lie."
Ella heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
Ruth heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
🌿 Xavier returns from foraging the wilds: +532 kcal to the pantry.
— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
Brian hesitates, then backs off. "Not today. Sorry." (Low trust — reluctant.)
💧 Brian returns with 8L, but the cistern only holds 2L more.
🍲 Brian cooked for the haven — meals stretched.
You catch fragments by the fire — Marcus telling Xavier about Cameron. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.
💧 Cameron returns with water: +3 clean.
💧 Tullio returns with water: +2 clean.
Mariela heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
Xavier heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
🎒 "Out past the ridge," Cameron says, already walking. "If I'm not back in a few days... well. I'll be back."
🍲 Tullio is hunched over their bowl by the fire, eating like it matters.
— NIGHT — Camp. Rest — or risk the dark.
Night settles. The fire is the whole world now. No watches posted. The dark feels bigger than it should.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
💛 You hold Carpenter's square and practice — one gift, deeply. They would want you to get better at this. (+6 experience to Survivor)
Travel 1 tile to grove.
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.
Travel 2 tiles to meadow.
You also take some vine (crafting material).
You work the patch with practiced hands: 3× Muscadine Grapes, 6× Blackberry (660 kcal). This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
Travel 1 tile to Haven.
While you were gone — 2 things you missed:
⚔️ Ella stared down the Anaconda Empress and it backed off — 0 rounds, not a scratch on them. It's still out there, somewhere.
⚔️ Xavier stared down the Anaconda Empress and it backed off — 0 rounds, not a scratch on them. It's still out there, somewhere.
You keep a day's food (660 kcal) — nothing extra for the pantry this time.
You walk back into Haven. 17 Codex entries. The village is glad to see you.
Tullio will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
📋 Brian — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
📋 Cameron — 🎣 Fish. Cameron nods eagerly. They'll report back by next part.
Brian doesn't say a word. They just stand there, arms crossed, until you finish giving the order. The silence does the talking.
"Enough," Brian says. "I want a say in how this village runs. A real say."
You chew the bitter leaves. Folk say it helps — you wouldn't know. (+2 health, maybe)
You eat Blackberry and Muscadine Grapes (660 kcal).
You settle into the hall floor. Sleep takes you.
🪨 Brian pries 1 stone loose from the creek bed. The building pile grows. (17 stone now.)
🪵 Cameron hauls back 10 wood. The pile grows. (90 logs now.)
You catch fragments by the fire — Brian telling Mariela about you. It's picking up decorations as it travels.
You catch fragments by the fire — Tullio telling Mariela about Ruth. Half of it's true anymore. You're not sure which half.
You catch fragments by the fire — Cameron telling Xavier about Ruth. The details have shifted. Nobody seems to mind.
🪤 Brian is back. "Snares were empty. They'll keep."
🪤 Brian is back from the pit line. "Pit was quiet. They'll keep."
Recipe: Snare (Level 1). You have seen a snare. A loop, a stick, an animal.

🪤 Brian catches you watching the snares come off the line. "...Want to actually SEE one?" They show you — the loop, the trigger stick, where the run narrows between the roots. "Opossum trails. Check at dawn. Always." Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
Recipe: Pit Trap (Level 1). A pit with stakes in the bottom. Dig it on a trail, brush it over, wait.

🪤 Brian catches you watching the pit line. "...Want to actually SEE one?" They walk you out to it — the depth, the sharpened stakes at the bottom, where the game trail runs. "Brush it over with leaves. And mark it well — your own pit will take you too." Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
💧 Ella returns with water: +2 clean.
💧 Marcus returns with water: +4 clean.
🔇 The birds have gone quiet. Even the crickets. The woods are holding their breath.
Something out there knows exactly where you sleep. It isn't howling. That's the worst part — it isn't making a sound at all.
Three shapes at the treeline — dog-shaped silences, circling. (A real pack is out there now: 3 of them. No names yet — nobody's lived to argue about one.)
Investigate and the morning is gone — tracking them costs a full day-part. Bar the door and you learn nothing. Your call.
A cold snap. Breath smokes. The woods go quiet.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
Village meal: +1197 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
Zoe is staring into the fire like it owes them answers.
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Zoe Adams is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
◈ CRISIS — THE FIRST GRAVE. Zoe is dead. The village digs its first grave, and everyone understands at once: this place can kill you. It just did.
SYSTEM: "Oh. Oh no. Was that supposed to happen? The audience is crying. I did not know they could do that."
📖 The entry for Zoe is finished. 3 deeds recorded. No more pages.
💀 Zoe is gone. The wound was too much. Nobody eats much tonight. The pot stays full and nobody touches it.
Tullio and Landon lingered over the fire together.
🤢 Ruth's stomach knots — something in their meal was off.
— DAY 17 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
👀 Dmitri let a place-name slip — somewhere that isn't Denver — then covered it with "Denver" so fast the cover was louder than the slip.
Snow by morning. (1°C — Cold) The ground goes iron — forage thin, walking dear.
Mariela Lazzari reads the sky: clear tomorrow, cold.
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
Dawn. You wake rested. (+24 health, energy restored. Your sleeping body burned less — 175 kcal conserved. By the fire. Good enough.)
You are full enough.
The pantry is in the hall. Your hands are not.
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
📋 Brian — 💧 Fetch water. They'll report back by next part.
🌱 Tullio waters and weeds the beds before taking up other work. The harvest can wait.

🌿 Tullio checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~19 days of fresh on hand… leaves the harvest standing and turns to the water run instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.
💧 Tullio returns with 8L of creek water. Risky until the hearth boils it.
💧 Brian returns with 8L, but the cistern only holds 2L more.
You catch fragments by the fire — Cameron telling Marcus about you. It's picking up decorations as it travels.
You catch fragments by the fire — Landon telling Ella about you. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.
You catch fragments by the fire — Tullio telling Mariela about you. It's picking up decorations as it travels.
🩹 Landon is still hurting (26 HP) — no healer at haven. They rest today instead of ranging out.
💧 Mariela returns with water: +4 clean.
🩹 Dmitri is still hurting (38 HP) — no healer at haven. They rest today instead of ranging out.
💧 Ruth returns with water: +3 clean.
💧 Xavier returns with water: +3 clean.
📖 Xavier is showing Brian the Daylily Bud — leaf, stem, smell.
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
The relief moment passes — the crisis runs its own course now. What you did stands; what you didn't, doesn't.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
🪨 Brian pries 1 stone loose from the creek bed. The building pile grows. (18 stone now.)
🍲 Brian cooked for the haven — meals stretched.
Xavier showed Landon the Daylily Bud — "remember it." Word gets around.
Brian heads out to check the snares. "Wire doesn't lie."
Ella heads out to forage. "Out for a forage. If I'm late, start without me."
Someone's retelling it again — Xavier, out past the ridge. Mariela says "Xavier would've gone farther if we'd let them."
— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
🪵 Brian hauls back 5 wood. The pile grows. (93 logs now.)
🍲 Brian cooked for the haven — meals stretched.
You catch fragments by the fire — Xavier telling Cameron about Mariela. The retelling is already better than the event.
You catch fragments by the fire — Brian telling Cameron about you. The story's getting bigger than what happened.
— NIGHT — Camp. Rest — or risk the dark.
The fire burns lower than it should. Nobody wants to be the one to go for wood in the dark.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
⬆️ Survivor deepened to L3! You cannot be outlasted: hunger and cold break first.
"Yes! YES! That's the comprehension we calibrated for! Keep going! The sponsors are doubling down!"
💛 You hold Dad's Thermos and practice — one gift, deeply. They would want you to get better at this. (+6 experience to Survivor)
📖 LEARNED: Old World Caches (Level 1). You know where people hid things: under floorboards, in hollow trees, behind loose bricks.
You've learned Old World Caches — it carries Eagle Eye.

Travel 2 tiles to forest floor.
— Under the canopy —
Fallen trunks lie like sleeping animals, furred with moss. The ground gives underfoot — centuries of leaf-mold.
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Hushpuppy is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Hushpuppy: Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free. (Two survived encounters — the fire has a theory.)
📓 Codex: Counter: Wound the lead — Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free.
You catch fragments by the fire — Mariela telling Dmitri about Brian. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.

Travel 1 tile to forest floor.
— Under the canopy —
Mushrooms thumb up through the duff in a ring — a fairy ring, old as the path. You step around it, not through it. Some rules are older than knowledge.
Movement — a great horned owl, silent and huge.
👁 It waits for YOU to come close — the stillness is the trap. Spot the shape before you're in reach, and strike first. It only gets one.

Travel 2 tiles to trail edge.
— An old trail —
Something walked here regularly, before. The path remembers even if no one does.
It followed you. The Drum-Belly is here.
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Ella is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
📖 The entry for Ella is finished. No more pages.
Movement — an armadillo rooting in the leaf litter, armor clanking.
👁 It doesn't run — the armor IS the plan. It'll hunch down and dare you. The armor turns a blow; grab the soft underbelly, or trap the grub trail at night.
You clear the rubble, stone by stone. The path is clear.
You pocket 2 good throwing stones. (sling ammo)
It sits up and drums a little paradiddle, watching to see if you flinch.
A fallen tree blocks the path.

Travel 1 tile to trail edge.
— An old trail —
The trail is worn smooth as an old coin. Deer, probably. Probably.
The Drum-Belly stops at the boundary — pacing, unwilling. Something else is already here. It's still out there.
Unfamiliar unknown berries — into the bag. (Unknowns lump together; sort them at camp.)
You also take some vine (crafting material).
Journal: Trampled ground. The humble weeds win.
Journal updated: a tall tree with dark peeling bark and long hanging clusters of small dark cherries grows here too — better than blackberry.
You work the patch: 3× Blackberry — and 2× unknown berries you can't name yet. This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
Travel 1 tile to trail edge.
You make a Stone knife. flint knapped to an edge, bound with vine. cuts meat, wood, cord.
You chew the bitter leaves. Folk say it helps — you wouldn't know. (+2 health, maybe)
You eat Blackberry (195 kcal).
Your chewing echoes off the trees. Something out there heard. (encounters more likely tomorrow)
Dawn's an hour off — too late for real sleep. Rest a while instead, or wait for morning.
Equipped Stone knife (melee).
💧 Brian returns with 12L, but the cistern only holds 0L more.
🍲 Brian cooked for the haven — meals stretched.
Cameron showed Dmitri the Daylily Bud — "remember it." Word gets around.
🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the northwest called Stonebridge. The region is bigger than your fire.
📨 Word came: Tashi Sherpa wants to join Haven. "Heard about this place three valleys over. Had to try." — they haven't set foot here. The village will judge.
It's settled. The village is calling it "Loud-Eyes." The Codex keeps it.
⬢ SYSTEM: "Neural depth 65. I can hold more of you now — ability slots: 5."
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+5 integration)
A cold snap. Breath smokes. The woods go quiet.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
You camp wild tonight — no pantry meal. Eat from your pack.
📓 Codex: The old argument between Ruth and Ella ended — one of them is gone.
— DAY 20 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, unknown berries went bad — beyond saving. You leave it for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
🎁 You find a small bundle tucked where you'll find it. No one saw it left there.
"They're sending Vex after you tomorrow. He's bored. Be somewhere else."
(499 kcal of dried meat and clean water. Nothing traceable.)

💬 Marcus pulls you aside. "I need to tell you something. Last night I... dreamed? No. I was AWAKE. And something spoke to me. Not the System — something else. It said: 'Tell the human to watch the northern treeline.' Then it was gone."
(Marcus has been contacted by something. They don't understand what happened. But they'll warn you when they dream again.)
Mariela Lazzari reads the sky: clear tomorrow, cold.
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
Dawn. You wake stiff and half-frozen. (-15 health, restless night. The cold got in — no healing, and it took its cut. (Sleeping unsheltered in a cold snap is a mistake you only make once.))
You are full enough.
The pantry is in the hall. Your hands are not.
Need a fire to boil water.
Drank clean water.
Quacking, loose and wandering. Just ducks. Probably just ducks.
The hissing stopped. All heads turned toward you at once.

(The game is telling you something: this is bigger than one person. Talk to your companions — "We should name this. Us.")

The village's quarrel was with Adrian — and Adrian is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
At the grave, Brian speaks for Cameron — "Adrian trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.

⛓️ Brian brings it home: Haven bows to Emberhold — one organization, them primary. Tribute: 5,000 kcal/week. The relationship starts at trust 30. Everything from here is earned.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Brian speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
Three weeks. That's how long before a handshake is a relationship — the System will say so when it's true. Tend this fire.
📓 Codex: First link formed with Emberhold. The gesture goes out now; the Dawn waits for seasons.

◈ SYSTEM: "FIRST CONTACT, people! Do you KNOW what this is? This is the PILOT for a whole new SHOW. Two fires! One story! The cameras are already fighting over angles — smile, little fires, you're SOMEBODY now."
Marcus: "We're not alone anymore. They know our NAMES."
Tullio: "They're watching what we do FIRST. So let's do it right."
The System's overlay stretches — new edges, new names. Coordination layer: warming up. It'll be ready when the bond is.
